records.real_world_identity_notes: The PMR observation resolves to the TVR Tuscan T400R race-car family represented by the existing curated record tvr-tuscan-t400r-gt2. PMR identifies its implementation as the 2004 TVR Tuscan T400R in N-GT, while the existing record uses a GT2-era label for the same T400R race family. TVR's 2004 press material and the PMR page both describe a six-speed sequential gearbox. Period race archives document multiple T400R chassis and event classifications, so N-GT and later GT2 are treated as regulatory/context labels rather than silently turning the submission into a different road-going Tuscan, T440R, Typhon, or Tuscan Challenge car. The exact PMR chassis and exact race-period driver interface are not identified.

records.specification_basis: PMR, TVR's 2004 press kit, and the period brochure all describe a six-speed sequential gearbox. The official PMR page and contemporary TVR manufacturer material explicitly identify the T400R gearbox as sequential. The gearbox is explicitly described as six-speed sequential by PMR and TVR manufacturer material. This does not settle the physical actuation interface. Manual blip is modeled as a downshift action; no upshift-blip claim is asserted about the car. Automatic blip is modeled as a downshift action; no upshift-blip claim is asserted about the car. Throttle lift is modeled as an upshift action; no separate downshift-lift claim is asserted about the car. Automatic cut is modeled as an upshift action; no downshift-cut claim is asserted about the car. The reviewed sources did not establish the remaining technique and wheel fields, which stay unknown in the real-car baseline: /authentic_controls/transmission/shift_actuation, /authentic_controls/transmission/standing_start_clutch, /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/clutch, /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/throttle_lift, /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/automatic_cut, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/clutch, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/manual_blip, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/automatic_blip, /authentic_controls/steering/wheel_rim/shape, /authentic_controls/steering/wheel_rim/open_top, /authentic_controls/steering/wheel_rim/integrated_display, /authentic_controls/steering/wheel_rim/shift_lights.
